stemMarkdown: Three pipes A, B and C can fill a tank in 12, 24 and 30 hours respectively. If all three are opened together, how many hours will the tank take to fill? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Combined rate $= \dfrac{1}{12} + \dfrac{1}{24} + \dfrac{1}{30} = 0.158333$ tanks per hour, so the time is $6.3158$ hours.
